commands: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r'); echo call_state=$STATE; test "$STATE" = "0"; echo bluetooth_on=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '\r'); echo '=== bluetooth_manager help ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd bluetooth_manager help 2>&1 | head -80; echo route_prep_diagnosis=true
